pois.name: 宗谷
pois.intro: Sōya is a Japanese icebreaker that serves as a museum ship in Tokyo after a long and storied service spanning some of the 20th century's historic events. She is named after Sōya Subprefecture in Hokkaido.

pois.name: 浜離宮恩賜庭園
pois.intro: Hama-rikyū Gardens is a metropolitan garden in Chūō ward, Tokyo, Japan. Located at the mouth of the Sumida River, it was opened to the public on April 1, 1946.

pois.name: 皇居
pois.intro: The Imperial Palace is the main residence of the emperor of Japan. It is a large park-like area located in the Chiyoda district of the Chiyoda ward of Tokyo and contains several buildings, including the Fukiage Palace, where the emperor has his living quarters; the main palace, where various ceremonies and receptions take place; some residences of the Imperial Family; an archive; and museums and a...

pois.name: お台場
pois.intro: Odaiba is a large artificial island in Tokyo Bay, Japan, across the Rainbow Bridge from central Tokyo. Odaiba was initially built for defensive purposes in the 1850s.

pois.name: 国立新美術館
pois.openingHours: Su-Mo,We-Th 10:00-18:00; Fr-Sa 10:00-20:00; Tu off; Dec 26-Jan 10 off
pois.intro: The National Art Center, Tokyo is a museum in Roppongi, Minato, Tokyo, Japan. Opened in January 2007, it is one of the five institutions of the Independent Administrative Institution National Museum of Art.

pois.name: 迎賓館
pois.intro: Akasaka Palace is a state guest house of the government of Japan. Other state guesthouses of the government include the Kyoto State Guest House.

pois.name: 代々木公園
pois.intro: Yoyogi Park is a park in Shibuya, Tokyo, Japan. It is located adjacent to Harajuku Station and Meiji Shrine in Yoyogikamizonochō.

pois.name: 東京国立近代美術館
pois.nameEnglish: National Museum of Modern Art, Tokyo
pois.intro: The National Museum of Modern Art, Tokyo, also known as MOMAT, is the foremost museum collecting and exhibiting modern Japanese art. The museum, in Chiyoda, Tokyo, Japan, is known for its collection of 20th-century art and includes Western-style and Nihonga artists.

pois.name: 新宿御苑
pois.openingHours: Mo off; Oct 01-Mar 14 Tu-Su 09:00-16:30; Mar 15-Jun 30 Tu-Su 09:00-18:00; Jul 01-Aug 20 Tu-Su 09:00-19:00; Aug 21-Sep 30 Tu-Su 09:00-18:00; Dec 29-Jan 03 off
pois.intro: Shinjuku Gyo-en or Shinjuku Gyoen National Garden is a large public garden in Shinjuku and Shibuya, Tokyo, Japan. Originally a residence of the Naitō family in the Edo period, it later became a garden under the management of Japan Imperial Household Agency and is now a national garden under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of the Environment.

pois.name: 都立夢の島公園
pois.intro: Yumenoshima Park is a sports park in Yumenoshima, Kōtō Ward, Tokyo, Japan. It was made by improving a landfill site called Yumenoshima, which was the final disposal site for garbage from 1957 until 1967.

pois.name: 葛西臨海公園
pois.intro: Kasai Rinkai Park is a park in Edogawa, Tokyo, Japan, which officially opened on 1 June 1989. The park includes a bird sanctuary and the Tokyo Sea Life Park aquarium, as well as the Diamond and Flower Ferris Wheel.

pois.name: 江戸東京博物館
pois.wikipedia: ja:東京都江戸東京博物館
pois.intro: The Edo-Tokyo Museum is a historical museum located at 1-4-1 Yokoami, Sumida-Ku, Tokyo in the Ryogoku district. The museum opened in March 1993 to preserve Edo's cultural heritage, and features city models of Edo and Tokyo between 1590 and 1964.

pois.name: 日本科学未来館
pois.intro: The National Museum of Emerging Science and Innovation, simply known as the Miraikan, is a museum created by Japan's Science and Technology Agency. It was opened in 2001.

pois.name: アーティゾン美術館
pois.intro: Artizon Museum Aatizon Bijutukan, until 2018 Bridgestone Museum of Art, is an art museum in Tokyo, Japan. The museum was founded in 1952 by the founder of Bridgestone Tire Co., Ishibashi Shojiro.

pois.name: Shibuya 109
pois.intro: 109 is a department store in Shibuya, Tokyo, Japan. The store is operated by SHIBUYA109 Entertainment Corporation, a subsidiary of the Tokyu Group.

pois.name: 大奥跡
pois.intro: The Ōoku was historically the women's quarters of Edo Castle, the section where the women connected to the reigning shōgun resided. Similar areas in the castles of powerful daimyō, such as the Satsuma Domain, were also referred to by this term.

pois.name: 雲鷹丸
pois.intro: Un'yō was a Taiyō-class escort carrier originally built as Yawata Maru, one of three Nitta Maru-class cargo liners built in Japan during the late 1930s. She was transferred to the Imperial Japanese Navy during the Pacific War, renamed, and was converted into an escort carrier in 1942.

pois.name: 船の科学館
pois.intro: The Museum of Maritime Science was a marine science museum located in Higashiyashio, Shinagawa, Tokyo on Odaiba island, Japan. In 2011 the museum announced to cease the most parts of its operation for renovation, while keeping some functions active, including exhibit of Sōya, scientific research and educational programs.

pois.name: ジョイポリス
pois.intro: Joypolis is a chain of indoor amusement parks created by Sega and run by CA Sega Joypolis. Beginning on July 20, 1994 with the original location sited in Yokohama, Japan, Joypolis centers have since opened in several cities in Japan and later China.

pois.name: 根津美術館
pois.intro: The Nezu Museum, formerly known as the Nezu Institute of Fine Arts, is an art museum in the Minato district of Tokyo, Japan. The museum is home to the private collection of pre-modern Japanese and East Asian art assembled by Nezu Kaichirō.

pois.name: 荏原 畠山美術館
pois.address: 東京都港区白金台2-20-12, 白金台二丁目, 〒108-0071
pois.wikipedia: en:Hatakeyama Memorial Museum of Fine Art
pois.intro: The Hatakeyama Memorial Museum of Fine Art is a private museum established in October 1964 in Tokyo, Japan. In October 2024, the museum was renamed the Ebara Hatakeyama Museum of Art.

pois.name: 東京都現代美術館
pois.intro: The Museum of Contemporary Art Tokyo is a contemporary art museum in Koto, Tokyo, Japan. The museum is located in Kiba Park.

pois.name: 東京都写真美術館
pois.intro: The Tokyo Photographic Art Museum is an art museum concentrating on photography. As the Tokyo Metropolitan Museum of Photography, it was founded by the Tokyo Metropolitan Government, and is in Meguro-ku, a short walk from Ebisu station in southwest Tokyo.

pois.name: チームラボ プラネッツ
pois.intro: teamLab Planets TOKYO DMM.com is an art museum that utilizes digital technology and was established by teamLab and DMM.com. It is located in 6-chome, Toyosu, Koto-ku, Tokyo.

pois.name: サントリー美術館
pois.intro: The Suntory Museum of Art is an arts museum located in Tokyo Midtown, Roppongi, Tokyo. It is owned by the Suntory corporation.

pois.name: アクアパーク品川
pois.intro: Maxell Aqua Park Shinagawa, formerly Epson Aqua Park Shinagawa, Epson Shinagawa Aqua Stadium is a public aquarium located inside the Shinagawa Prince Hotel in Minato, Tokyo. It can be accessed from Shinagawa Station.

pois.name: アド・ミュージアム東京
pois.wikipedia: ja:アド・ミュージアム東京
pois.intro: Ad Museum Tokyo is an advertising museum in Shiodome in the Minato ward of Tokyo, Japan. Located in the basement of the Caretta Shiodome Building, it is the only museum in Japan dedicated to the promotion of studies in advertising.

pois.name: しながわ水族館
pois.intro: しながわ水族館（しながわすいぞくかん、SHINAGAWA AQUARIUM）は、東京都品川区のしながわ区民公園内南端にある水族館。

pois.name: 瀧爪 TAKIZME
pois.description: Serene tea house in Shinagawa, Tokyo, offering a mindful and relaxing tea experience. Service is either in English or Japanese.

pois.name: タコベル アクアシティお台場店
タリーズコーヒー 東京テレポート駅店
日比谷 松本楼
pois.intro: 松本楼（まつもとろう）は、株式会社日比谷松本楼が運営する日本の東京都千代田区日比谷公園内にある洋風レストランである。

pois.name: 海岸カフェ
pois.address: 東京港湾福利厚生センター, 港区, 108-0022

pois.name: タリーズコーヒー 品川インターシティ店
タリーズコーヒー ＆TEA 有明ガーデン店
東京 芝 とうふ屋うかい
pois.intro: Tofuya Ukai is a luxury tofu restaurant in Minato, Tokyo, located near Tokyo Tower. It is part of the Ukai group chain of restaurants.

pois.name: 元祖久留米らーめん 福ヤ
pois.description: 元祖とんこつ久留米ラーメン

pois.name: タリーズコーヒー グランドプリンスホテル新高輪店
Cocorotus Foodtruck
pois.description: 国際興業三田第二ビルでの定期出店場所です。キッチンカーのため、施設の代表住所と実際の出店位置が離れている場合があります。地図上の登録地点を目印にお越しください。

pois.name: Cocorotus Foodtruck
pois.description: 芝での定期出店場所です。キッチンカーのため、施設の代表住所と実際の出店位置が離れている場合があります。地図上の登録地点を目印にお越しください。

pois.name: 日本橋弁松総本店
pois.intro: 日本橋弁松総本店（にほんばしべんまつそうほんてん）は、東京都中央区日本橋室町一丁目にある惣菜と折詰料理の店舗である。 「現存する日本で最古の弁当屋」と言われている。

pois.name: タリーズコーヒー ダイバーシティ東京プラザ店
pois.wikipedia: ja:タリーズコーヒージャパン
pois.intro: タリーズコーヒージャパン株式会社（英: Tully's Coffee Japan Co.,Ltd.）は、日本においてコーヒーショップ「タリーズコーヒー」の経営を行っている会社である。伊藤園の完全子会社（連結子会社）である。

pois.name: GINZA SIX
pois.intro: Ginza Six is a luxury shopping complex located in the Ginza area of Tokyo, jointly developed by Mori Building Company, J. Front Retailing, Sumitomo Corporation and L Catterton Real Estate. The name Ginza Six or G Six reflects the building address in Ginza 6-chome as well as the desire to provide an exceptional "six-star" shopping experience.

pois.name: 東京ミッドタウン日比谷
pois.wikipedia: ja:東京ミッドタウン日比谷
pois.intro: Tokyo Midtown Hibiya is a 190,000-square-meter mixed-use development in Yurakucho, Tokyo, Japan. Completed in March 2018, the project includes office, commercial, and dining and entertainment facilities.

pois.name: 西銀座
pois.intro: 株式会社西銀座デパート（にしぎんざデパート）は東京都中央区銀座でテナントビル型のショッピングセンターNISHIGINZA（ニシギンザ）を運営する企業。同社はデパートと称するが日本百貨店協会には加盟していない。

pois.name: 東京駅一番街
pois.intro: 東京駅一番街（とうきょうえきいちばんがい、英: First Avenue Tokyo Station）は、東京都千代田区と中央区に掛かる、東京駅八重洲口にある商業施設。東海旅客鉄道（JR東海）100%子会社の東京ステーション開発が運営する。

pois.name: ヨドバシカメラ マルチメディアAkiba
pois.address: １一１ ヨドバシカメラ マルチメディアAkiba, 千代田区, 101-0028
pois.intro: Yodobashi-Akiba – centrum handlowe zlokalizowane w Akihabarze zostało otwarte 16 września 2005 roku.

pois.name: 日本橋三越本店
pois.intro: 日本橋三越本店（にほんばしみつこしほんてん）は、東京都中央区日本橋室町に所在する、三越伊勢丹が運営する百貨店。三越ブランドの本店である（三越伊勢丹の商業登記上の本店は伊勢丹新宿店）。

pois.name: 潮風公園
pois.intro: Shiokaze Park is a public park and was a temporary beach volleyball sport venue for the 2020 Summer Olympics, located in Tokyo, Japan.

pois.name: お台場海浜公園
pois.intro: Le parc marin d'Odaiba est un parc urbain situé sur l'île artificielle d'Odaiba, dans le quartier de Minato de Tokyo. Le parc est baigné par les eaux de la baie de Tokyo.

pois.name: 有明テニスの森公園
pois.intro: Ariake Tennis Park is a park in the Ariake district of Kōtō, Tokyo that was used for the 2020 Summer Olympics. The park has many tennis courts, a lawn plaza, a jogging course, a walking path, and the Ariake Coliseum.

pois.name: 旧芝離宮恩賜庭園
pois.intro: The Kyū Shiba Rikyū Garden, also known as Kyū Shiba Rikyū Onshi Teien is a public garden and former imperial garden in Minato ward, Tokyo, Japan. The garden is one of four surviving Edo-period clan gardens in Tokyo, the others being Koishikawa Kōraku-en, Rikugi-en, and Hama Rikyu Garden.

pois.name: 清澄庭園
pois.intro: Kiyosumi Garden is a traditional Japanese stroll garden located in Fukagawa, Tokyo. It was constructed along classic principles in 1878–85, during the Meiji Period, by the shipping financier and industrialist Iwasaki Yatarō.

pois.name: 東京都夢の島熱帯植物館
pois.intro: The Yumenoshima Tropical Greenhouse Dome, also sometimes called the Yumenoshima Tropical Plant Dome, is a botanical garden located at 3-2, Yumenoshima, Kōtō, Tokyo, Japan. It is operated by the Tokyo Metropolitan Park Association, and is open daily except on Mondays; an admission fee is charged.

pois.name: 国立科学博物館附属自然教育園
pois.nameEnglish: Institute for Nature Study, National Museum of Nature and Science
pois.wikipedia: ja:国立科学博物館附属自然教育園
pois.intro: The Institute for Nature Study is a Japanese nature preserve park associated with the National Museum of Nature and Science, located in the Shirokanedai neighborhood of Minato, Tokyo, extending into the Kamiōsaki neighborhood of Shinagawa, Tokyo. It is a Natural Monument and a National Historic Site of Japan.

pois.name: LOVE sign, Statue of Liberty, and Rainbow Bridge view
pois.nameEnglish: LOVE sign, Statue of Liberty, and Rainbow Bridge view
pois.description: この人気の写真スポットは、特に夜に魅力的なレインボーブリッジと自由の女神の素晴らしい景色を提供します。カップルや訪問者が思い出に残る瞬間を捉えるための魅力的な場所です。

pois.name: 台場一丁目商店街
pois.intro: 台場一丁目商店街（だいばいっちょうめしょうてんがい）は、東京都港区台場のデックス東京ビーチにあるテーマゾーン。昭和30年代をイメージしたレトロな町並みを再現した商店街で、いわゆるレトロテーマパークの一つである。

pois.name: Small Worlds Tokyo
pois.intro: Small Worlds Miniature Museum is a museum of miniature models in the Ariake district of Kōtō, Tokyo. Opened in 2020 with approximately 7,000 square meters of floor space, it is the largest miniature museum in Asia.

pois.name: キッザニア東京
pois.intro: KidZania Tokyo is a family edutainment center amusement park, in the LaLaport Toyosu, Tokyo, Japan opened in October 2006. A part of the Mexican Kidzania franchise, Kidzania Tokyo is the third ever Kidzania theme park ever built, preceded by Mexico City and Monterrey, and succeeded by Kidzania Jakarta.

pois.name: 汐留SIO-SITE
pois.intro: Shiodome is an area in Minato, Tokyo, Japan, located adjacent to Shinbashi and Ginza, near Tokyo Bay and the Hamarikyu Gardens. Formerly a railway terminal, Shiodome has been transformed into one of Tokyo's most modern areas.

pois.name: 葛西臨海水族園
pois.intro: Tokyo Sea Life Park is a public aquarium located in Kasai Rinkai Park, Edogawa Ward, Tokyo. Its predecessor was the Ueno Aquarium in the Ueno Zoo.

pois.name: 赤坂サカス
pois.intro: akasaka Sacas is a commercial complex in Akasaka, Tokyo, Japan, where the TBS Broadcasting Center and the site of the "Akasaka 5-chome TBS Development Project" stand.

pois.name: ブレッドマチエール　カフェ&バル
THE CITY BAKERY アトレ品川
渋谷Parco
pois.intro: 渋谷PARCO（しぶやパルコ）は、 東京都渋谷区宇田川町にある複合商業ビル。株式会社パルコが運営するファッションビルブランド「PARCO（パルコ）」の旗艦店であり、パルコ全店の中で最大の取扱高を有する。
